description: This PHP class defines a 'Scientific' number format wizard as part of the PhpSpreadsheet library, used for formatting numbers in scientific notation with configurable decimal places and locale support.

classes.name: Scientific
classes.description: A class that formats numbers in scientific notation with configurable decimal precision and locale, implementing the Wizard interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the number of decimal places and locale for scientific formatting.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Returns the format string for the locale, internally calls format() method.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates and returns a string representing the scientific number format pattern based on the current decimal settings.
